Gamma-ratio asymptotics prove fixed-real-shape limits. Companion Python 3 checker passed 3,202 finite tests; universal proof is analytical.

value.rationale: A sharp, nontrivial finite-degree two-Jacobi-parameter regularization coefficient quantifies how much a canonical positive smoother can steepen arbitrary bounded rough input. It yields complete endpoint localization and actual extremizing sign functions, identifies exact n-dependence and a fixed-weight asymptotic, and differs mathematically from existing global Dobrushin and approximation/spectral estimates.
